content.title: About
content.content: Rockstar is an energy drink containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and sugar (or its substitutes). It is designed to boost energy, improve focus and reduce fatigue during intense physical and mental activities.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Rockstar brand was founded in 2001 in the United States and quickly became a market leader in energy drinks.
The formula often includes guarana extract, which adds an extra energy kick.
Rockstar is available in more than 30 flavors, including original, berry, tropical and sugar‑free versions.
The company actively supports extreme sports, sponsoring skateboarding, BMX and CrossFit events.
In some countries the drink is sold as “Zero” – sugar‑free but with the same caffeine level.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine and taurine stimulate the central nervous system, enhancing attention and reaction time.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins help convert food into usable energy.

items.title: Improved physical endurance
items.content: The combination of sugar (or substitutes) and stimulants can speed up recovery after intense workouts.

items.title: Excessive caffeine intake
items.content: High doses may cause anxiety, insomnia, rapid heartbeat and increased blood pressure.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sugared versions can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries with frequent consumption.

items.title: Not suitable for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to its high caffeine level, the drink is not recommended for people under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of certain stimulants and antidepressants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Chill the drink and consume in small servings (200–250 ml) before training, during work, or when feeling fatigued. Do not exceed 2–3 servings per day.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, it is best consumed within 30 days.
